
# Description

Égalité (egalite) provides functions
for checking whether two given variables,
including arrays or objects, are equal by value.
When used on non-objects, it works like strict
equality (===).

# Usage examples

```
> equal([1, 2], [1, 2])
true
> equalArrays([1, 2], [1, 2])
true
> equal([1, 2], [2, 1])
false
> equal({a: 1}, {a: 1})
true
> equalObjects({a: 1}, {a: 1})
true
> equal(null, 0)
false
```

# Installation

```
> npm install @bhbr/egalite
```
